title: Know the Greeks and the trade-offs in every payoff
summary: Most option traders lose because they do not understand the basics. First, the Greeks: delta, gamma, theta and vega. Second, payoff profiles and their trade-offs: a higher win rate means a lower payout, more theta costs gamma, and more time costs more premium. The third point is cut off in the transcript.

steps.caption: Delta: how much the option moves with the stock.
Gamma: a short option is short gamma. Big moves hurt.
Theta: the short option earns time decay. More theta costs you gamma.
Vega: exposure to changes in implied volatility.
No free lunch: every gain in one Greek is paid for in another.

takeaways: Learn delta, gamma, theta and vega.
Every payoff profile has trade-offs: higher win rate, lower payout.
More theta means more short gamma; more time means a higher price.
